obligations.local_use: Running unmodified copies obtained from PyPI. GPL/LGPL conditions attach to conveying/distribution (GPL-3.0 s2, LGPL-2.1 s0: running is not restricted); permissive licences' notice conditions attach to copies/redistribution made by the distributor. No project obligation identified; not a legal opinion
obligations.ci_use: Same as local while the runner downloads from PyPI and only the six allowlisted JSON files are uploaded (no cache, image push or binary artifact). Any upload/cache/push of the venv, wheelhouse or image would be redistribution
obligations.redistribution: Not permitted by this assessment. Would require: licence texts and copyright notices for all components (including Semgrep and statically linked code); LGPL corresponding source or written offer and relinking ability for GMP, elfutils, keyutils, glibc libm/libresolv, libdwarf, Semgrep and the ocaml-tree-sitter binding; GPL runtime-exception texts for libgcc/libstdc++; Apache-2.0 for OpenSSL; corresponding source for semgrep-core itself (built from a non-public tree)
